description: Search Kroger's public product catalog, or look up products by UPC, product URL or category.

availability.description: Keep all products, only products in stock, or only products currently out of stock.
availability.title: Availability

categoryUrls.description: Kroger category page URLs such as `https://www.kroger.com/pl/fresh-fruit/06111`, or a numeric taxonomy ID like `06111`.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or IDs (mode=byCategory)

maxPrice.description: Only emit products whose regular price is at or below this amount.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Only emit products whose regular price is at or above this amount.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

mode.description: What to collect: a keyword search, UPC lookups, product URLs or whole category pages.
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Kroger product page URLs such as `https://www.kroger.com/p/<slug>/<upc>`. The UPC is read from the URL.
productUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=byProductUrl)

searchQueries.description: Keywords for mode=search, e.g. `milk`, `coffee`, `protein bars`. Results from all queries are combined and deduplicated.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

upcs.description: Kroger UPC/GTIN codes to look up, 12-14 digits. Each code is searched and returned once.
upcs.title: UPCs (mode=byUpc)

title: Kroger Catalog Scraper Input
